messages:
Anna D: Quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR to update the status page link and add a short workaround for today's routing outage. Need 2 reviewers and a merge window before the next deploy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823
Keon: link?
Anna D: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — changes: 1) replace broken status page URL, 2) add 'Known issues' note + minimal rollback/playbook snippet, 3) update SDK example to use client-token.
Samira: I'll take first pass now. @Keon can you double-check the SDK snippet for accuracy? :eyes:
ci-bot: Docs preview build queued: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/builds/90712 — status: queued
Linus (oncall): Please include the exact commands ops should run for the rollback. A single line curl or kubectl snippet is easiest to follow.
Anna D: Adding recommended rollback snippet in PR, example:
```
# disable routing rule, fallback to regional pool
curl -X POST https://ops-api.redwood.ai/routing/disable -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_API_KEY" -d '{"rule":"edge-primary"}'
```
Also added a short note pointing to status.redwood.ai#routing-outage
Keon: LGTM for the rollback snippet. One nit: rename `legacy-token` -> `client-token` in the SDK examples to match the runtime API. I'll push a tiny commit to the branch.
Samira: Preview currently shows code block overflow on mobile — adding `code-compact` wrapper and re-running preview.
ci-bot: Docs preview build started: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/builds/90712/2
ci-bot: Docs preview build succeeded: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/builds/90712/2 — status: success
Samira: Approved :white_check_mark:
Keon: Approved from me as well. Ops plans a controlled deploy at 17:15 UTC; can we merge ~17:00 so there's a small buffer?
Anna D: I'll merge at 16:55 UTC and queue the deploy. @Linus (oncall) please watch traces for the first 10 minutes after deploy.
Linus (oncall): Will monitor. If we see >3x baseline P50 or error-rate >1% I'll rollback and open an incident in #incidents.
Anna D: Merged and pushed. Final PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — release tag: r-2026-03-21-doclinkfix
Samira: Thanks — can someone add a one-line to release notes: "Updated status page link and added routing-outage workaround"?
Keon: Done and linked in the release checklist.
